text:
morgan: FYI new customer onboarding failing. SSO returns 500, SCIM calls return 400 with 'missing roles'. Happened after this morning's RBAC deploy. Anyone?

dev-bot: Deploy completed 2026-03-21T09:04:02Z for infra/rbac-service by raj

sara: Can you paste the SCIM request/response and any SAML errors?

morgan: SCIM POST /scim/v2/Users payload minimal (userName, name, externalId) -> 400 error: "attribute 'roles' is required for provisioning to this tenant"

morgan: SAML auth-proxy log: "failed to decrypt assertion: kms:Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException"

raj: KMS deny + missing roles smells like RBAC mapping change removed a mapping the SCIM adapter expects and we also rotated a key earlier so auth-proxy lost kms:Decrypt.

elaine: ops-bot did maintenance at 08:50, did a scheduled key rotation. ops-bot, can you confirm?

ops-bot: KMS alias alias/redwood-sso rotated 2026-03-21T08:47:31Z, rotation run succeeded. No exceptions recorded in automated runbook.

sara: Two actions: (1) check key policy includes service accounts (svc-auth-proxy and any new svc-rbac), (2) rollback or patch RBAC mapping so SCIM doesn't require roles for this tenant.

morgan: Checked key policy -> principals: svc-auth-proxy and svc-kms-rotator, NOT svc-rbac. Auth-proxy used svc-rbac to call KMS after RBAC changes. KMS AccessDenied confirmed.

raj: I'll revert the RBAC mapping commit to restore previous behavior. Morgan, can you add svc-rbac to key policy temporarily and restart auth-proxy? Keep change timeboxed.

morgan: Adding role arn:aws:iam::111111:role/svc-rbac to key policy now, then kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-proxy -n sso. Will paste exact commands for audit.

dev-bot: auth-proxy restart initiated by morgan at 2026-03-21T09:18:01Z

morgan: SAML now decrypts: "assertion decrypted, audience validated". SCIM replayed for tenant-42 with X-Replay: true -> 200 user created but downstream role assignment still missing until RBAC revert finishes.

raj: RBAC revert deployed to canary, monitoring 5m.

sara: Please capture timeline for postmortem: key rotation 08:47, RBAC deploy 09:04, auth-proxy errors 09:06-09:18, mitigation steps and follow-ups.

morgan: Commands added to incident doc: aws kms get-key-policy/put-key-policy edits and kubectl restart. Filed PR #4123 to make SCIM adapter tolerant of missing roles and to queue retries on RBAC lookup failure.

elaine: Also add CI test simulating missing KMS principal during rotation.

sara: Good. Marking incident mitigated, will keep thread open for PM review. :white_check_mark:
